dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct horizontal white bands across the coverts; the upper band is thicker and shows high grayscale contrast against the dark background feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale edges along folded primary and secondary feathers, creating a clear parallel linear pattern.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast, roughly oval-shaped white patch located centrally on the posterior nape/neck region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, distinct linear boundary separating the blackish crown/nape from the uniform gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: A white/silver colored metal identification ring is visible on the lower right leg.
